title: pp.freqshift-st~
description: `pp.freqshift-st~` is the stereo version of `pp.freqshift~`, shifting input signals in frequency by a specified number of hertz using single-sideband modulation and a quadrature transform. Set the shift through its frequency-shift signal inlet or with a `frequency-shift` control message; it also supports saving and recalling up to 20 presets.
